items.issue: M2-27 spike (c), D-36 and K-24 require measuring which process macOS privacy prompts name for a daemon-started server. Protected-folder and local-network attribution remain unmeasured. Green CI and the development-host launchd restriction do not establish this behavior.
items.suggested_fix: On a real Mac using a signed EnvCloak build, start the server through the managed daemon runner. Perform one protected-folder read and one local-network request. Record which process each prompt names, the macOS version and build, and the EnvCloak build version and signing identity. Record the outcome of each operation and whether a prompt appeared; pre-existing consent or no prompt does not establish prompt attribution and needs a fresh eligible test context. Update the macOS privacy prompts bullet in docs/MIGRATE-MCP.md and the validation receipt with the measured limits and evidence before closing this entry.

items.where: M2 plan M2-15 Tests first; crates/envcloak-e2e/tests/managed_launch.rs and managed_runner.rs
items.issue: The M2-27 plan requires the managed negative-case matrix under no grant, a session grant and a standing record. Standing-policy issuance belongs to M2-15. Its list covers the managed sh -c and replaced-executable cases but does not explicitly retain the foreign-client recipient boundary under a standing record.
items.suggested_fix: Add a permanent macOS and Linux gate using a bound native launch and a real eligible standing record created through the supported proof path. A foreign client naming that exact launch with its own pipes must receive started and the fixture protocol, never a value. Assert the standing record actually covers this request without a fresh pending request or a once/session grant masking it; sweep all client-visible output and readable memory for the generated fixture in every encoding, with a positive leak-detector control; assert zero client releases and a runner release. Pair with the genuine hardened-client positive control. Mutation: return the values to the requesting foreign client instead of only the daemon-started runner; the sweep and release counter must fail. Sweep the rest of the standing matrix too: explicit-manifest sh -c, upward search, replaced executable, changed cwd/script/environment, and old-revision re-registration; retain each applicable positive control and refusal-before-pending assertion. Update the M2-15 tests-first list and M2-27 gate/requirement receipt before closing this entry.
